newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek PM given mandate for new government.
newsitem.headline: Greek PM given mandate for new government.

text.p: Greek prime minister-elect Costas Simitis said on Monday he had received a mandate from President Costis Stephanopoulos to form a new four-year socialist government.
Simitis, talking to reporters after leaving Stephanopoulos's residence, said he would announce the members of his government within the next few days. Under the mandate he has three days.
He won a solid victory over the opposition conservatives in Sunday's election, taking about 41.5 percent of the vote and 162 deputies in the 300-seat parliament.
Simitis, 60, is expected to make major changes in the cabinet which he inherited in January when he took over as prime minister from late socialist party founder Andreas Papandreou.
